passages.text: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD after Nebuzaradan captain of the guard had released him at Ramah, having found him bound in chains among all the captives of Jerusalem and Judah who were being exiled to Babylon.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet of the LORD.
Nebuzaradan was the captain of the guard.
Nebuzaradan found Jeremiah at Ramah.
Jeremiah was bound in chains.
He was among all the captives from Jerusalem and Judah.
These captives were being exiled to Babylon.
After Nebuzaradan released Jeremiah at Ramah, a word came to Jeremiah from the LORD.
passages.original: הַדָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־ הָיָ֤ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה אַחַ֣ר׀ שַׁלַּ֣ח אֹת֗וֹ נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֛ן רַב־ טַבָּחִ֖ים מִן־ הָֽרָמָ֑ה בְּקַחְתּ֣וֹ אֹת֗וֹ וְהֽוּא־ אָס֤וּר בָּֽאזִקִּים֙ בְּת֨וֹךְ כָּל־ גָּל֤וּת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ וִֽיהוּדָ֔ה הַמֻּגְלִ֖ים בָּבֶֽלָה׃

passages.text: The captain of the guard found Jeremiah and said to him, “The LORD your God decreed this disaster on this place, and now the LORD has fulfilled it; He has done just as He said. Because you people have sinned against the LORD and have not obeyed His voice, this thing has happened to you.
passages.sermon:
Nebuzaradan was the captain of the guard.
He found Jeremiah.
He spoke to Jeremiah.
He said, “The LORD is your God.
The LORD spoke about this disaster.
He spoke about this place.
The LORD has brought this disaster.
The LORD has done what He said.
You people sinned against the LORD.
You did not obey His voice.
Because of this, this disaster has happened to you.”
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֥ח רַב־ טַבָּחִ֖ים לְיִרְמְיָ֑הוּ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ דִּבֶּר֙ אֶת־ הָרָעָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את אֶל־ הַמָּק֖וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ וַיָּבֵ֥א וַיַּ֛עַשׂ יְהוָ֖ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֵּ֑ר כִּֽי־ חֲטָאתֶ֤ם לַֽיהוָה֙ וְלֹֽא־ שְׁמַעְתֶּ֣ם בְּקוֹל֔וֹ וְהָיָ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם דָּבָר הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: But now, behold, I am freeing you today from the chains that were on your wrists. If it pleases you to come with me to Babylon, then come, and I will take care of you. But if it seems wrong to you to come with me to Babylon, go no farther. Look, the whole land is before you. Wherever it seems good and right to you, go there.”
passages.sermon:
Nebuzaradan was the captain of the guard.
He spoke to Jeremiah.
He said, “Today I am setting you free.
You were in chains on your wrists.
Now you are no longer bound.
If you want to come with me to Babylon, then come.
If you come, I will watch over you.
If you do not want to come with me to Babylon, then do not come.
You are free to choose.
Look, the whole land is open before you.
Go wherever you think is good and right.
Go wherever you wish.”
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֞ה הִנֵּ֧ה פִתַּחְתִּ֣יךָ הַיּ֗וֹם מִֽן־ הָאזִקִּים֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ יָדֶךָ֒ אִם־ ט֨וֹב בְּעֵינֶ֜יךָ לָב֧וֹא אִתִּ֣י בָבֶ֗ל בֹּ֚א וְאָשִׂ֤ים אֶת־ עֵינִי֙ עָלֶ֔יךָ וְאִם־ רַ֧ע בְּעֵינֶ֛יךָ לָבֽוֹא־ אִתִּ֥י בָבֶ֖ל חֲדָ֑ל רְאֵה֙ כָּל־ הָאָ֣רֶץ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ אֶל־ ט֨וֹב וְאֶל־ הַיָּשָׁ֧ר בְּעֵינֶ֛יךָ לָלֶ֥כֶת שָׁ֖מָּה לֵֽךְ׃

passages.text: But before Jeremiah turned to go, Nebuzaradan added, “Return to Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon has appointed over the cities of Judah, and stay with him among the people, or go anywhere else that seems right.” Then the captain of the guard gave him a ration and a gift and released him.
passages.sermon:
Nebuzaradan was the captain of the guard.
Jeremiah had not yet turned to go.
Nebuzaradan spoke to Jeremiah.
He said, “Return to Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan.
The king of Babylon has appointed Gedaliah over the cities of Judah.
Stay with Gedaliah among the people.
Or go anywhere else that seems right to you.
Go wherever you wish.”
Then the captain of the guard gave Jeremiah a ration and a gift.
He released Jeremiah.
passages.original: וְעוֹדֶ֣נּוּ לֹֽא־ יָשׁ֗וּב וְשֻׁ֡בָה אֶל־ גְּדַלְיָ֣ה בֶן־ אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן־ שָׁפָ֡ן אֲשֶׁר֩ הִפְקִ֨יד מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֜ל בְּעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה וְשֵׁ֤ב אִתּוֹ֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעָ֔ם א֠וֹ אֶל־ כָּל־ הַיָּשָׁ֧ר בְּעֵינֶ֛יךָ לָלֶ֖כֶת לֵ֑ךְ וַיִּתֶּן־ ל֧וֹ רַב־ טַבָּחִ֛ים אֲרֻחָ֥ה וּמַשְׂאֵ֖ת וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֵֽהוּ׃

passages.text: So Jeremiah went to Gedaliah son of Ahikam at Mizpah and stayed with him among the people who were left in the land.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet of God.
Gedaliah son of Ahikam was the governor appointed by the king of Babylon.
Mizpah was a city in Judah.
Jeremiah went to Gedaliah at Mizpah.
Jeremiah stayed with Gedaliah.
Jeremiah lived among the people who remained in the land.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֧א יִרְמְיָ֛הוּ אֶל־ גְּדַלְיָ֥ה בֶן־ אֲחִיקָ֖ם הַמִּצְפָּ֑תָה וַיֵּ֤שֶׁב אִתּוֹ֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעָ֔ם הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֖ים בָּאָֽרֶץ׃ס

passages.text: When all the commanders and men of the armies in the field heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam over the land and that he had put him in charge of the men, women, and children who were the poorest of the land and had not been exiled to Babylon, they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah—Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth, the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah son of the Maacathite—they and their men.
passages.sermon:
The king of Babylon appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam over the land of Judah.
Gedaliah was now the leader in Judah.
The king put Gedaliah in charge of the people who remained in the land.
These people included men, women, and children.
They were the poorest people of the land.
They had not been taken away to Babylon.
All the commanders of the armies in the field heard about this.
Their men also heard about Gedaliah’s appointment.
The commanders and their men came to Gedaliah at Mizpah.
Ishmael son of Nethaniah came.
Johanan and Jonathan, the sons of Kareah, came.
Seraiah son of Tanhumeth came.
The sons of Ephai the Netophathite came.
Jezaniah son of the Maacathite came.
All these commanders and their men came to Gedaliah.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ֩ כָל־ שָׂרֵ֨י הַחֲיָלִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּשָּׂדֶ֗ה הֵ֚מָּה וְאַנְשֵׁיהֶ֔ם כִּֽי־ הִפְקִ֧יד מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֛ל אֶת־ גְּדַלְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־ אֲחִיקָ֖ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְכִ֣י׀ הִפְקִ֣יד אִתּ֗וֹ אֲנָשִׁ֤ים וְנָשִׁים֙ וָטָ֔ף וּמִדַּלַּ֣ת הָאָ֔רֶץ מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ הָגְל֖וּ בָּבֶֽלָה׃ וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶל־ גְּדַלְיָ֖ה הַמִּצְפָּ֑תָה וְיִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן־ נְתַנְיָ֡הוּ וְיוֹחָנָ֣ן וְיוֹנָתָ֣ן בְּנֵֽי־ קָ֠רֵחַ וּשְׂרָיָ֨ה בֶן־ תַּנְחֻ֜מֶת וּבְנֵ֣י׀ עוֹפַי הַנְּטֹפָתִ֗י וִֽיזַנְיָ֙הוּ֙ בֶּן־ הַמַּ֣עֲכָתִ֔י הֵ֖מָּה וְאַנְשֵׁיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, swore an oath to them and their men, assuring them, “Do not be afraid to serve the Chaldeans. Live in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will go well with you.
passages.sermon:
Gedaliah was the son of Ahikam.
Ahikam was the son of Shaphan.
Gedaliah spoke to the commanders and their men.
Gedaliah swore an oath to them.
He said, “Do not be afraid to serve the Chaldeans.
Stay in the land.
Serve the king of Babylon.
If you do this, it will go well for you.”
passages.original: וַיִּשָּׁבַ֨ע לָהֶ֜ם גְּדַלְיָ֨הוּ בֶן־ אֲחִיקָ֤ם בֶּן־ שָׁפָן֙ וּלְאַנְשֵׁיהֶ֣ם לֵאמֹ֔ר אַל־ תִּֽירְא֖וּ מֵעֲב֣וֹד הַכַּשְׂדִּ֑ים שְׁב֣וּ בָאָ֗רֶץ וְעִבְד֛וּ אֶת־ מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל וְיִיטַ֥ב לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: As for me, I will stay in Mizpah to represent you before the Chaldeans who come to us. As for you, gather wine grapes, summer fruit, and oil, place them in your storage jars, and live in the cities you have taken.”
passages.sermon:
Gedaliah was the governor appointed by the king of Babylon.
Gedaliah spoke to the people of Judah.
He said, “I will stay in Mizpah.
I will stand before the Chaldeans who come to us.
I will represent you to them.
You must gather wine.
You must gather summer fruit.
You must gather oil.
Put these things in your storage jars.
Live in the cities you have taken.”
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֗י הִנְנִ֤י יֹשֵׁב֙ בַּמִּצְפָּ֔ה לַֽעֲמֹד֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָבֹ֖אוּ אֵלֵ֑ינוּ וְאַתֶּ֡ם אִסְפוּ֩ יַ֨יִן וְקַ֜יִץ וְשֶׁ֗מֶן וְשִׂ֙מוּ֙ בִּכְלֵיכֶ֔ם וּשְׁב֖וּ בְּעָרֵיכֶ֥ם אֲשֶׁר־ תְּפַשְׂתֶּֽם׃

passages.text: When all the Jews in Moab, Ammon, Edom, and all the other lands heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant in Judah and had appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, over them, they all returned from all the places to which they had been banished and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah at Mizpah. And they gathered an abundance of wine grapes and summer fruit.
passages.sermon:
The king of Babylon left a remnant of people in Judah.
He appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, to rule over them.
Jews lived in Moab, Ammon, Edom, and many other lands.
These Jews heard what the king of Babylon had done.
They heard that a remnant remained in Judah.
They heard that Gedaliah was appointed as their leader.
All these Jews returned from every place where they had been scattered.
They came to the land of Judah.
They came to Gedaliah at Mizpah.
They gathered a great amount of wine grapes and summer fruit.
passages.original: וְגַ֣ם כָּֽל־ הַיְּהוּדִ֡ים אֲשֶׁר־ בְּמוֹאָ֣ב׀ וּבִבְנֵֽי־ עַמּ֨וֹן וּבֶאֱד֜וֹם וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּכָל־ הָֽאֲרָצוֹת֙ שָֽׁמְע֔וּ כִּֽי־ נָתַ֧ן מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֛ל שְׁאֵרִ֖ית לִֽיהוּדָ֑ה וְכִי֙ הִפְקִ֣יד עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אֶת־ גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־ אֲחִיקָ֥ם בֶּן־ שָׁפָֽן׃ וַיָּשֻׁ֣בוּ כָל־ הַיְּהוּדִ֗ים מִכָּל־ הַמְּקֹמוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִדְּחוּ־ שָׁ֔ם וַיָּבֹ֧אוּ אֶֽרֶץ־ יְהוּדָ֛ה אֶל־ גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ הַמִּצְפָּ֑תָה וַיַּאַסְפ֛וּ יַ֥יִן וָקַ֖יִץ הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃פ

passages.text: Meanwhile, Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the armies in the field came to Gedaliah at Mizpah and said to him, “Are you aware that Baalis king of the Ammonites has sent Ishmael son of Nethaniah to take your life?” But Gedaliah son of Ahikam did not believe them.
passages.sermon:
Johanan was the son of Kareah.
He was a leader among the people.
All the commanders of the armies were with him.
These commanders were in the field.
They all came to Gedaliah.
Gedaliah was the son of Ahikam.
Gedaliah was at Mizpah.
Johanan and the commanders spoke to Gedaliah.
They said, “Baalis is the king of the Ammonites.
Baalis has sent Ishmael.
Ishmael is the son of Nethaniah.
Baalis sent Ishmael to kill you.”
Gedaliah did not believe them.
Gedaliah was the son of Ahikam.
passages.original: וְיֽוֹחָנָן֙ בֶּן־ קָרֵ֔חַ וְכָל־ שָׂרֵ֥י הַחֲיָלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּשָּׂדֶ֑ה בָּ֥אוּ אֶל־ גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ הַמִּצְפָּֽתָה׃ וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו הֲיָדֹ֤עַ תֵּדַע֙ כִּ֞י בַּעֲלִ֣יס׀ מֶ֣לֶךְ בְּנֵֽי־ עַמּ֗וֹן שָׁלַח֙ אֶת־ יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן־ נְתַנְיָ֔ה לְהַכֹּתְךָ֖ נָ֑פֶשׁ וְלֹא־ הֶאֱמִ֣ין לָהֶ֔ם גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־ אֲחִיקָֽם׃

passages.text: Then Johanan son of Kareah spoke privately to Gedaliah at Mizpah. “Let me go and kill Ishmael son of Nethaniah,” he said. “No one will know it. Why should he take your life and scatter all the people of Judah who have gathered to you, so that the remnant of Judah would perish?”
passages.sermon:
Johanan was the son of Kareah.
He spoke to Gedaliah in private at Mizpah.
Johanan said, “Let me go and kill Ishmael son of Nethaniah.
No one will know about it.
If Ishmael kills you, all the people of Judah who have gathered to you will scatter.
Then the remnant of Judah will perish.”
passages.original: וְיוֹחָנָ֣ן בֶּן־ קָרֵ֡חַ אָמַ֣ר אֶל־ גְּדַלְיָהוּ֩ בַסֵּ֨תֶר בַּמִּצְפָּ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר אֵ֤לְכָה נָּא֙ וְאַכֶּה֙ אֶת־ יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן־ נְתַנְיָ֔ה וְאִ֖ישׁ לֹ֣א יֵדָ֑ע לָ֧מָּה יַכֶּ֣כָּה נֶּ֗פֶשׁ וְנָפֹ֙צוּ֙ כָּל־ יְהוּדָ֔ה הַנִּקְבָּצִ֣ים אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְאָבְדָ֖ה שְׁאֵרִ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: But Gedaliah son of Ahikam said to Johanan son of Kareah, “Do not do such a thing! What you are saying about Ishmael is a lie.”
passages.sermon:
Gedaliah was the son of Ahikam.
Johanan was the son of Kareah.
Gedaliah spoke to Johanan.
Gedaliah said, “Do not do this thing.”
Gedaliah said, “You are speaking falsely about Ishmael.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר גְּדַלְיָ֤הוּ בֶן־ אֲחִיקָם֙ אֶל־ יוֹחָנָ֣ן בֶּן־ קָרֵ֔חַ אַֽל־ תַּעַשׂ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה כִּֽי־ שֶׁ֛קֶר אַתָּ֥ה דֹבֵ֖ר אֶל־ יִשְׁמָעֵֽאל׃ס
